name: mri_spine
description: Order an MRI of the spine (cervical, thoracic, or lumbar) to evaluate disc herniation, spinal cord compression, infection, tumor, and nerve root impingement.

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., radiculopathy, myelopathy, cauda equina syndrome)

when_to_use: suspected cauda equina syndrome (MRI lumbar spine STAT)
radiculopathy not improving with conservative management
suspected spinal cord compression or myelopathy
spinal epidural abscess or discitis/osteomyelitis evaluation
intradural or intramedullary spinal tumor characterization

examples.query: Patient with bilateral leg weakness, saddle anesthesia, urinary retention
